query: I want to bump our go.mod from go 1.21 to go 1.24. What changes?
expected_behavior: Runs godebugdiff.go with --to 1.24 on the module
For each change that reaches a binary, searches the code for the API the setting names and says whether it's used

query: This PR raises the go directive from 1.22 to 1.25. Anything to worry about?
expected_behavior: Mentions runtime settings like containermaxprocs that apply to every binary
Says the tool only covers GODEBUG defaults, not every release note change

query: godebugdiff says nothing changes. So the Go upgrade is safe, right?
expected_behavior: Explains that only GODEBUG defaults are covered
Doesn't claim the upgrade is safe

query: We use a go.work workspace. I want to raise its go line from 1.21 to 1.24. What changes?
expected_behavior: Runs godebugdiff.go with --work --to 1.24 on the workspace root
Reads the go line from go.work, not a module go.mod
Says that workspace pins use //go:debug or GODEBUG because go.work has no godebug lines
